implementation: ACodeZombieActor caches base skeletal, primitive body, primitive head, and glow component transforms, then applies non-collision visual offsets during runtime combat states.
playability_result: Zombie movement reads as authored motion even when a final montage or AnimBP clip is missing.

implementation: UpdateMotionReadability drives step bob, side sway, forward lean, and component tags while a zombie is chasing or tracking inside activation range.
playability_result: Direct pursuit enemies look alive during chase instead of sliding with only glow feedback.

implementation: UpdateMotionReadability pulls the body back during bTelegraphingAttack, while TriggerAttackMotionCue pushes an attack-lunge pose during cover strikes and player attacks.
playability_result: Players can see a readable pre-hit windup and a commit motion before zombie damage resolves.

implementation: ApplyRescueDamage calls TriggerHitReactionMotionCue after ApplyHitReadabilityImpulse on nonfatal damage, adding a short recoil pose and hit-react audit tags.
playability_result: Successful shots produce visible enemy recoil even when the imported hit-react montage is unavailable.

implementation: Protected-zone Tick flow calls UpdateMotionReadability with bProtectedLearningHold so zombies visibly hold/lean back while pressure is suspended.
playability_result: The coding safehouse still shows enemy pressure waiting outside without allowing attacks inside the learning zone.

implementation: ResetMotionReadabilityPose restores cached component transforms while dying, and skips components already simulating physics.
playability_result: Additive pose offsets do not fight ragdoll, primitive corpse physics, or final death montages.
